reason: Reduce dense positive budget to make termination relatively more attractive. Scale down distance_reward from 0.5 to 0.2, vertical_speed_reward from 0.3 to 0.1, angle_reward from 0.1 to 0.05. This reduces the dense_to_objective_ratio from 0.21 to ~0.07, encouraging the policy to terminate after landing rather than hovering to collect dense rewards.
preserved_design: one-shot terminal success_bonus (100 at termination if success condition met)
progress-conditioned engine penalties (main_penalty and orientation_penalty conditioned on both_legs_contact)
diagnostic variables (distance_to_pad, vertical_speed, angle_deviation, main_engine_firings, orientation_engine_firings, both_legs_contact, crash_occurred, success_flag)
changed_design: distance_reward: scale reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 (max per-step reward from 0.5 to 0.2)
vertical_speed_reward: scale reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 (max per-step reward from 0.3 to 0.1)
angle_reward: scale reduced from 0.1 to 0.05 (max per-step reward from 0.1 to 0.05)
required_edits_implemented: Make completion/objective bonuses one-shot or terminal-aligned so they cannot fire every step.
Remove repeatable proxy-success payment modes that can be farmed without episode completion.
Keep dense progress signals bounded and smaller than episode-scale objective signals.
Add diagnostics for success_flag/objective_bonus so post-training audits can verify payment count.
forbidden_edits_avoided: Do not increase raw per-step action or engine bonuses.
Do not let objective_bonus exceed roughly one terminal event per episode.
Do not define success only as a non-terminal state predicate if it pays a large reward repeatedly.
do not increase repeatable per-step bonuses without event/progress gating
rejected_patterns_avoided: single_component_dominance: success_bonus remains one-shot, not repeatable.
large_dense_budget: dense rewards are scaled down to reduce the dense_to_objective_ratio.
action_coverage_plan: All four discrete actions remain available. The revised reward does not change action space. The policy should still use all actions for stabilization and descent. The main change is that dense rewards are smaller, so the policy will be less incentivized to hover and more incentivized to terminate after landing.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_reward (max 0.2) and vertical_speed_reward (max 0.1) still guide descent but with lower magnitude. Phase 2 (descent): engine penalties remain mild and conditioned on not being landed. Phase 3 (touchdown): success_bonus (100) is now relatively more attractive compared to dense rewards, encouraging the policy to complete the episode after landing.
payment_mode_plan: success_bonus: one-shot terminal event (paid only at termination if success condition met). main_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). orientation_engine_penalty: progress-conditioned (reduced when both legs contact). distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward, angle_reward: per-step but scaled down to reduce dense budget.

expected_metric_changes.dense_positive_budget: decrease from 1512.25 to ~500 (reduce distance_reward, vertical_speed_reward, angle_reward scales)
expected_metric_changes.dense_to_objective_ratio: decrease from 0.21 to ~0.07 (objective becomes relatively more attractive)
expected_metric_changes.success_like_terminal_rate: increase from 0.8 to >0.9 (policy more incentivized to terminate)
expected_metric_changes.generated_reward: decrease from 433.47 to ~200-300 (closer to fitness score)

validation_metrics: Static reward validator must not detect repeatable objective_bonus or non-terminal proxy-success farming.
success_flag_mean <= 1.2 (large success payments should not repeat many times per episode)
objective_bonus_mean <= 120.0 (one +100 objective event per episode is the expected scale)
generated_minus_fitness_gap <= 500.0 (generated reward should stay comparable to evaluator fitness)
